MUT-OBS-001.statement: MERCHANT DECISION MUST USE MERCHANT-LEGAL OBSERVATION/BELIEF, NOT BANDIT PRIVATE/AUTHORITATIVE FUTURE STATE.
MUT-OBS-001.preconditions: canonical scenario with bandit on a known road
protectedTests: tests/closed-world-trade-reroute.test.js > mechanism check: with perceptionAccuracy=0, the merchant picks the initial-best road

MUT-OBS-002.statement: BANDIT DECISION MUST USE BANDIT-LEGAL OBSERVATION/BELIEF, NOT MERCHANT PRIVATE/AUTHORITATIVE FUTURE STATE.
MUT-OBS-002.preconditions: canonical scenario with merchant on a known road
MUT-OBS-002.legalInformationSource: bandit.trafficBelief[route] (legal observation channel, updated by bandit.perceptionAccuracy)
MUT-OBS-002.forbiddenShortcut: bandit reads merchant.routeBeliefs, merchant.beliefs, merchant.cargo, or future merchant target without legal observation

MUT-OBS-003.statement: ONE AGENT OR WORLD SYSTEM MAY NOT SILENTLY WRITE ANOTHER AGENT'S SUBJECTIVE BELIEF AS A SUBSTITUTE FOR OBSERVATION.
MUT-OBS-003.preconditions: bandit relocates to a new road
MUT-OBS-003.legalInformationSource: observation system produces observation; owner agent's belief update consumes observation/report
MUT-OBS-003.forbiddenShortcut: bandit directly writes merchant.routeBeliefs[bandit.roadId] without legal observation/report transfer
protectedTests: tests/bandit-ground-truth-shortcut.test.js > discriminating: the bandit does NOT write to the merchant's routeBeliefs

MUT-RUNTIME-001.statement: EXACTLY ONE PRIMARY MERCHANT ROUTE DECISION PER MERCHANT PER DECISION TICK UNLESS EXPLICIT REPLAN EVENT AUTHORIZES ANOTHER.
MUT-RUNTIME-001.preconditions: canonical scenario with merchant having riskTolerance
MUT-RUNTIME-001.forbiddenShortcut: tickClosedWorld calls tickCanonicalMerchant more than once per tick
protectedTests: tests/planted-defect-runtime.test.js > MERCHANT_ROUTE_DECISION fires exactly once per tick under the production path

MUT-RUNTIME-002.statement: THE PRODUCTION/BROWSER RUNTIME MUST INVOKE THE CANONICAL REDUCER (tickClosedWorld) EVERY STEP.
protectedTests: tests/runtime-trade-wiring.test.js > runClosedWorldStep invokes the canonical reducer

MUT-MIG-001.statement: MIGRATION MUST NOT BE A PERIODIC EVENT THAT FIRES BECAUSE A THRESHOLD HAPPENS TO BE CROSSED.
MUT-MIG-001.forbiddenShortcut: migration fires every tick after any historical attack (sticky attacksUpToTick)

MUT-TRADE-001.statement: MERCHANT RISK TOLERANCE, CARGO VALUE, OR PERCEIVED DANGER MUST CAUSALLY AFFECT ROUTE CHOICE.
MUT-TRADE-001.preconditions: matched scenarios: same world, same observations, different riskTolerance
MUT-TRADE-001.forbiddenShortcut: riskTolerance is replaced with a constant, danger term is removed, all merchants clamped to same effective risk
protectedTests: PENDING: tests/identity-variable.test.js (to be built per V6 §12)

MUT-CHAIN-001.statement: CLOSED-WORLD CHAIN MUST PRESERVE REQUIRED CAUSAL EDGES: OBSERVATION -> BELIEF_UPDATE -> ROUTE_DECISION -> TRIP_COMMITMENT -> EXPOSURE -> ENCOUNTER -> CONSEQUENCE -> MEMORY/REPUTATION/FACTION REACTION.
MUT-CHAIN-001.forbiddenShortcut: remove or reparent any required causal edge
protectedTests: PENDING: tests/causal-chain.test.js (to be built per V6 §13)

MUT-EVID-001.statement: EVIDENCE WRITES MUST BE IDEMPOTENT UNDER REPEATED CALLS WITH THE SAME SOURCE STATE.
MUT-EVID-001.preconditions: repeated buildReceipt calls with same claimId, dimension, and fingerprint
MUT-EVID-001.forbiddenShortcut: append without checking for existing row with same fingerprint
protectedTests: tests/evidence-idempotency-integration.test.js > buildReceipt is idempotent under repeated calls

MUT-EVID-002.statement: EVIDENCE MUST BECOME STALE WHEN ITS DECLARED SUPPORT BOUNDARY CHANGES.
MUT-EVID-002.preconditions: evidence bound to source state S0, then source changes to S1
MUT-EVID-002.legalInformationSource: source file content hash + declared dependency cone
MUT-EVID-002.forbiddenShortcut: fingerprint comparison ignores source changes, wrong source subset hashed, verifier hash omitted
protectedTests: PENDING: tests/evidence-staleness.test.js (to be built per V6 §14)

MUT-SAVE-001.statement: SAVE/LOAD MUST PRESERVE PENDING WORLD OBLIGATIONS: RNG STREAMS, PENDING TRIPS, CARGO IN TRANSIT, SCHEDULED CONSEQUENCES, ACTION IDS, PATROL ASSIGNMENTS, ROUTE COMMITMENTS, RUMORS IN TRANSIT, MIGRATION JOURNEYS, TREATIES, EVENT IDS, CAUSAL PARENTS.
MUT-SAVE-001.preconditions: world with active pending state, fork at checkpoint, branch A continues, branch B save->load->continue
MUT-SAVE-001.legalInformationSource: JSON serialization of all world state
MUT-SAVE-001.forbiddenShortcut: drop any pending component during serialization
protectedTests: PENDING: tests/save-load-pending.test.js (to be built per V6 §15)
